the development of the adaptive variable structure controller for a nanopositioning system, which can be applied to other precision positioning systems.
the development and experimental validation of a novel motion control algorithm for precise positioning of a nanopositioner.
the design of a novel motion controller to improve the positioning accuracy of the nanopositioner.
